items.title: Steve Angrum Interview, 1961-08-08
items.q: That's the first brass band I was playing with... I've been playing with George now about ten years.

ctx.x: He could spell a little, but he didn't too much read. Yeah. I think George Lewis says that he liked him, too, and used to maybe copy him some, I don't know.

Yeah, George Lewis used to follow him around. What about your brass band work, Tim? What was the first brass band you played with? The first brass band? George, that's George Wynn band. That's the first brass band I was playing. Oh, yeah? Yeah, that's the first brass band I was playing with. I never played in Northern. How long have you been with your band? I've been playing with George now about ten years. You didn't do any brass band work before that? No. No, I didn't do any brass band work. But you must have…
They don't know where they at, come on.
